method: objdump --demangle --disassemble BINARY; extract the C3 SocBus refresh_irq and tick functions, count disassembly instruction lines and ldr q instructions. Counts are static compiled instructions, not dynamic CPU retirement counts.
build: cargo +1.99.0 build --release -p esp32sim --bin esp32sim; each arm uses a separate CARGO_TARGET_DIR
findings: The optional_words loop in 894ffa4 is already folded by the optimizer.
An unrestricted cached u32 defeats known-zero interrupt-source elimination in Lines::update. Masking to declared sources restores it; C3 uses only bit 23 in word 0.
A separate optional_irq flag compiles to unconditional cache loads plus a csel, adding four instructions relative to mask-only. This variant failed both comparisons and was dropped.
Moving inline PWM fields behind existing peripheral fields restores the C3 interrupt-map offset to main without changing scheduler behavior or allocating a new indirection.
The final tick function retains the existing active-list empty check, with optional ticking out of line. No PWM clock/IRQ queries occur in the empty-list scheduler path.
The constant-tag condition removes refresh_optional from ordinary dispatch_write arms. The extended OptionalChip test verifies ordinary writes and static IRQ scans cause no optional-model queries.

Moving optional ticking before the static loop shortens the delta-count lifetime. LLVM saves three register pairs instead of four and reduces the tick frame from 192 to 176 bytes; it also partially unrolls the static loop, increasing its static instruction count. Clock advancement, divider table, static-device order and scheduler cadence are unchanged.
privacy: Only compiled-function summaries, artifact hashes and relevant offsets retained. Full local disassembly stays in /tmp; no personal paths, process inventories or host identifiers are included.
